summary: Requesty grants approved early-stage startups $1,000 in credits spendable on any of 600+ models across 30+ providers, plus six months with no gateway fee (pay model cost only). After those six months the markup is 5% on model cost, or 0% with your own keys. Eligibility is VC or accelerator backing: YC, 20VC, Tapestry, TinyVC, or a comparable fund. Apply with a work email; Requesty says review is within 48 hours and credits are applied to the organization.
claim_steps: Confirm the company is backed by YC, 20VC, Tapestry, TinyVC, or a comparable accelerator or VC.
Apply at requesty.ai/startup with a work email, company name, affiliation, and optional raise details.
Wait for review (the page says within 48 hours); credits are applied to the organization.

social_proof.title: Startup Program | Requesty
social_proof.text: $1,000 in AI credits for early teams. Enough credit to build a real product on frontier models, and six months with no gateway fee while you do it. After the six months: 5% on model cost, or 0% with your own keys.
